## Changes
- **LAND shows the slope at the landing site.** A new **GROUND** row under the site shows the slope of the ground there and the slope above which this craft goes over after an upright touchdown, for any propellant left in the tanks. Above that slope the row turns to the warning colour and the footer says so. **FIND FLAT** looks for the flattest ground within 300 m, then 0.9 km and 2.7 km, and **MOVE SITE** moves the site there. DEORBIT + LAND refuses a site on which the craft cannot stand at any heading. ([#159](https://github.com/Maximilian-Nesslauer/KSA-AdvancedFlightComputer/pull/159))
- **Guidance settings are kept with the save.** The LAUNCH, LAND and TUNE settings of a craft are saved with the game save and come back when that save loads, also after a restart or a rename. A load gives back the settings only and starts nothing. The **SHOW IN MAP** and **SHOW IN WORLD** switches are kept for all craft. A landing no longer turns **AUTO WARP TO WINDOW** off. ([#157](https://github.com/Maximilian-Nesslauer/KSA-AdvancedFlightComputer/pull/157))

## Known limits
- The tip-over limit is a worst case: it counts with the lowest tanks near empty, so it can warn on a site that a craft with much propellant left survives.
- The LAN, the launch **TARGET** and the landing sites of boosters are not kept with the save.
- With **STEER BURN WITH GIMBAL** on, RCS translation and roll control are not available during the landing burn.
- An automatic entry from orbit on a body with air is refused.

AFC needs StarMap and no other mod.
